skill.name: performance-analysis
skill.description: Analyze Claude Flow swarm performance, find bottlenecks, and plan safe optimization steps.
skill.summary: Performance analysis guidance for Claude Flow swarms, reports, bottlenecks, and optimization planning.
skill.author: Claude Flow Team

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Markdown performance guide with explicit Claude Flow command examples and one sample Node.js script. I found no prompt injection, credential access, exfiltration intent, or hidden execution; the static findings are documentation or fixed-path examples rather than malicious behavior.

remediation.issue: Sample script uses child_process.exec for shell commands.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer execFile or spawn with argument arrays in examples, or clearly label the script as optional and user-reviewed.

remediation.issue: Automatic fix commands may change swarm configuration or runtime behavior.
remediation.suggestion: State that --fix commands require explicit user approval and should be tested outside production first.

remediation.issue: Documentation links include workstation-specific .claude absolute paths.
remediation.suggestion: Replace absolute hidden-directory links with repository-relative documentation links.

static_findings.snippet: - `--format <type>` - Report format: json, html, markdown (default: markdown)

- `npx claude-flow token usage` - Token optimization analysis
- `npx claude-flow agent metrics` - Agent performance metrics

content.value_statement: Claude Flow swarms can slow down when bottlenecks are hard to see. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through performance reports and optimization planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains bottleneck detection for communication, processing, memory, and network issues.
Documents Claude Flow commands for reports, monitoring, and metrics review.
Shows MCP calls for bottleneck checks and detailed task results.
Describes report sections, formats, comparisons, and CI integration patterns.
Recommends topology, caching, concurrency, priority, and resource optimizations.
limitations: Requires Claude Flow commands and swarm data to produce meaningful results.
Does not measure application performance outside the available swarm telemetry.
Command examples may need changes for each repository and workflow.
Automatic fixes need human review before production use.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Slow Swarms
use_cases.description: Find communication, task queue, memory, and resource bottlenecks in active Claude Flow swarms.

use_cases.title: Prepare Performance Reports
use_cases.description: Create markdown, HTML, or JSON reports that summarize metrics, trends, and improvement priorities.

use_cases.title: Tune Automation Pipelines
use_cases.description: Add performance checks to CI workflows and compare results across recent swarm runs.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Bottleneck Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for a current swarm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the performance-analysis skill to review the current Claude Flow swarm. Identify the top bottlenecks and explain the safest next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Team Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a readable report for a team review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the performance-analysis skill to create a markdown performance report for the last 24 hours. Include key metrics, bottlenecks, and recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Runs
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze changes between two swarm runs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the performance-analysis skill to compare this swarm with the previous run. Highlight regressions, improvements, and likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the performance-analysis skill to design an optimization plan. Include expected impact, validation steps, rollback risks, and commands that need approval.

output_examples.input: Review the current swarm for bottlenecks.
output_examples.output: A concise analysis lists communication delay as the main issue, explains the impact, and recommends topology changes plus cache review.

output_examples.input: Create a weekly performance report for engineering leadership.
output_examples.output: A report summary covers execution time trends, agent utilization, cache hit rate, critical findings, and prioritized next steps.

output_examples.input: Plan optimization for slow task execution.
output_examples.output: An action plan separates safe observations from changes that require approval, with validation metrics for each proposed fix.

best_practices: Start with read-only analysis before using any automatic fix option.
Compare results against a baseline so improvements are measurable.
Review command output and generated reports before changing swarm settings.
anti_patterns: Running automatic fixes without approval or a rollback plan.
Treating sample commands as universal commands for every repository.
Ignoring telemetry gaps when explaining performance changes.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes Claude Flow swarm performance, including bottlenecks, reports, metrics, and optimization options.

faq.question: Does it run benchmarks by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides analysis with Claude Flow commands and depends on available swarm telemetry.

faq.question: Can it create performance reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains report generation in markdown, HTML, and JSON formats.

faq.question: Can it apply automatic fixes?
faq.answer: It documents automatic fix options, but users should approve and test changes before production use.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for AI workflow operators, engineering leads, and DevOps engineers managing Claude Flow swarms.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
